Features / Plan
⬡ Plan

Planning that reflects your system.
Not a generic template.

Because Brunelly understands your architecture and business goals before planning begins, every story and sprint recommendation reflects the real complexity of what you're building — not a best-guess from a blank canvas.

⬡

Context-aware planning: Every work item Brunelly generates is grounded in your actual codebase, your team's velocity, and your product's architectural constraints. Planning stops being a guessing game and starts being a precision instrument.

⬡ Concept to Architecture

Describe your product.
Brunelly shapes the entire system.

Describe what you're building in plain language. Brunelly translates that into a structured system architecture — defining flows, roles, schemas, data models, and technology stack from the ground up. It stays with your product as a built-in technical lead as it evolves.

✓
Describe in plain language — Brunelly defines your architecture from the ground up
✓
Select your front end, back end, and database stack — Brunelly adapts to your choices
✓
System flows, roles, schemas, and data models defined before a line of code is written
✓
Architectural decisions recorded and carried forward across every subsequent stage
⬡ AI Story Generation

From concept to build-ready backlog — without the planning marathon.

Brunelly generates well-structured stories, tasks, and features with full acceptance criteria, BDD scenarios, personas, and definitions of done — all grounded in your architecture and business goals. What used to take days of back-and-forth becomes a single iterative flow.

✓
AI-generated stories with acceptance criteria, personas, and BDD scenarios built in
✓
Iterative refinement — Brunelly refines requirements until they are genuinely build-ready
✓
Quality scoring on every work item with concrete suggestions for improvement
✓
Rich templates for stories, bugs, features, and tasks with structured fields throughout
✓
Work items linked to architectural decisions — traceability from idea to implementation
⬡ Sprint Health Monitoring

See risks before they become blockers.

Brunelly monitors sprint health in real time — surfacing scope creep, velocity risks, and at-risk items before they derail delivery. Engineering managers get the visibility they need without the constant check-ins.

✓
Real-time sprint health indicators — scope creep, at-risk items, velocity risk flagged early
✓
Velocity tracking across sprints with trend analysis and forecasting
✓
Daily standup tracking — progress, blockers, and commitments in one view
✓
Team performance insights — identify patterns and optimise assignments over time

in minutes, not meetings.
